scope: Move two real gameplay text changes from incorrectly backdated 2021 snapshots into their actual balance patches. No cosmetic or tooltip-only adjustments.

EX1_365.effect: Holy Wrath gains minion-only restriction on the same date its cost changes from 5 to 3

EX1_608.effect: Sorcerer's Apprentice spells can no longer be reduced below 1 on the same date its cost changes from 4 to 2
